question: What Synology attachment retrieval and staging policy should the official plugin support before enabling inbound image, CSV, and PDF handling?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but accepting attachments changes a bundled channel's network and file-ingestion boundary, so automation should not choose the external contract or safety policy alone.

options.title: Confirm Contract And Safe Staging
options.body: Require a real Synology attachment payload/API contract, then implement bounded plugin-local retrieval with MIME, size, lifetime, cleanup, and regression tests before enabling the feature.

options.title: Wait For Redacted Payload
options.body: Keep the issue open until a user supplies redacted NAS webhook payloads and retrieval details so the implementation is not speculative.

options.title: Decline Official Plugin Support
options.body: Leave inbound Synology attachments unsupported unless maintainers decide this official plugin warrants the security review and maintenance cost.

recommendation.title: Confirm Contract And Safe Staging
recommendation.body: Require a real Synology attachment payload/API contract, then implement bounded plugin-local retrieval with MIME, size, lifetime, cleanup, and regression tests before enabling the feature.

likelyOwner.reason: Existing review context already routed the Synology attachment gap and security-boundary decision through this handle.
